name: A Husband's Last Battle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My husband traveled Felwood for the honor of our clan, doing battle against the Shadow Council and other corrupt atrocities!

After he escaped death numerous times, I received a letter from him saying that a druid asked him for help against a great befouled furbolg named Overlord Ror--the two were never heard from again.

I want this Ror's clawed hand, adventurer. I want it to pay for leaving me a widow! I believe the creature is to the south... near the Ashenvale border.
narrative.objectives: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You bring honor to me for following through with your word. My husband died in battle--he would have been proud of that. But I could not rest until I knew that the creature that has forced me to live my life alone paid for what it had done.

Thank you again, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the beast's claw yet, adventurer? It will pay for its crimes. I don't care if it's corrupt or just angry for living in such a dismal forest. No furbolg will live for long committing such crimes against my family!
